chapter: Hampton, New York and Lee's own band
title: Going to track meets with Art Tatum
summary: Lee never played with Tatum but walked with him at track meets, where he reacted to a pole vault before the crowd did.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Art Tatum: the legend, the piano and the man

blocks.x: Did you play with Tatum ever?

No, I never did. No, I didn't play with Tatum ever. I don't know if any drummers have played with Tatum, really. Because Tatum appeared -- I went over to see him at the Paramount Theatre, and I think Rube Wolfe was there, but I really idolized him; he used to go to a lot of track meets with Tatum.
You know, Tatum could see. He could see.
But could he see well enough to see a track meet?

Well, he would go. He'd go to baseball games. No, he couldn't really see --he could not see the track meet, but we went to many track meets together, and I learned to walk with him. He didn't like for you to lead him by the hand, and so when we'd go to track meets, I'd wear this white shirt and I'd get right in front of him ... and he saw a little, so he could see this glare, you know, and he would never stumble or anything, but when we saw the pole vault this day, I remember he was up before everyone. See, you lose one sense but they gain in another. He knew, like we'd say -- you'd say to him he's coming down the runway, you know, and he knows where the runway is, and he looked there, and what made me know that he really didn't see him, is because he jumped up before the crowd jumped up. You know, the guy hadn't even gotten to the top of the pole, and he jumped up and he said, 'He made it!' But then the guy did make it, for a world's record, you know, but he didn't see it. That's the only thing -- I had my doubts; I used to say I really believe this cat is really seeing these things. Because he could sit there, and they would run the 220 -- he knew when they were gonna hit that tape, you know; he really did. He was an amazing man and an amazing musician, as you know.
